provenance.translation: Direct translation of public site text; names paired by game ID with official game localization.

1001.name: Grudge
1001.effect:
When another ally dies, the ally with the lowest SP gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn.
※Unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ. Active while in the team but not deployed.

1002.name: Bloodied Hands
1002.effect:
The slowest ally gains +1 Final Power for their last skill.
※Unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ. Active while in the team but not deployed.

1003.name: Stubbornness

The ally with the lowest current HP takes 10% less damage.
※Unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ. Active while in the team but not deployed.

1004.name: Jugar con Enemigos

The ally with the highest SP deals +10% damage when attacking an enemy with lower SP than themselves.

1008.name: Too Slow
1008.effect:
When the fastest ally successfully Evades, gain 1 Haste next turn (up to 5 times).
※Unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ. Active while in the team but not deployed.

1009.name: Flaring Brand
1009.effect:
When the first ally in deployment order lands a Heads hit, inflict 1 Burn Count (up to 4 times per turn).
※Unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ. Active while in the team but not deployed.

1010.name: Contract Target Protection
1010.effect:
At Turn End, grant 1 Haste and 3 Defense Level Up next turn to the ally with the lowest HP percentage.
※Unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ. Active while in the team but not deployed.

1011.name: Speedy Courier
1011.effect:
When the fastest ally hits an enemy with Rupture, inflict 1 Defense Level Down (max 3 per enemy per turn).
※Unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ. Active while in the team but not deployed.

1012.name: We've Got Your Back

At Combat Start, the ally with the lowest current HP percentage gains 2 Defense Level Up.

※Unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ. Active while in the team but not deployed.

1013.name: Reloader
1013.effect:
At the end of an attack by the first Ammo-using ally in deployment order, if their current Ammo is below half of maximum, reload half their maximum Ammo (rounded up; once per encounter; max 5 Ammo gained).
- If Ammo has separate Potency and Count, randomly replenish either.
- If either Potency or Count is at its maximum, gain the other type instead.
- Does not activate if no Identity uses Ammo.
※Unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ. Active while in the team but not deployed.
